authors: Mayukh Debnath, Adeyinka Adedigba, Rammohan Mallipeddi

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26964，Comments 为 '10 pages, 1 figure, 17 supplementary pages'）：这篇的结论带两次证伪，都可迁移。(1) 结构难度不需要再训一个预测器——'the zero-training delete-relaxation heuristic h_add outperforms learned alternatives on held-out domains (mean Spearman |rho|=0.931)'，而学到的对照分别是 ridge regression 0.707、object count 0.657、episodic retrieval architecture ARC 0.400；更狠的一句是 'ARC also fails to outperform a linear model using the same features'。(2) 语义可读性是独立的一维——他们 'progressively rename predicates while preserving states, transitions, and optimal plans'，即状态空间不变只改命名，结果 'Valid LLM planning success drops from 67.5% to 40.0% between 0% and 100% renaming, while refusals remain at 0%'；'refusals remain at 0%' 这句很关键，说明模型是安静地做错而不是承认不会。(3) 结论直接落在工程上：'Hybrid routing between an LLM and a symbolic planner depends more on calibration to the target LLM's outcomes than on the structural score selected'，以及 'improving hybrid planning requires modeling LLM behavior sensitive to predicate semantics rather than developing more structural predictors'。价值路由：这不是一篇要给 LLM 加规划器的方法论文，而是一篇告诉我们 '别往哪个方向投预算' 的选型约束——domain complexity 该用 h_add 现算而不是训模型；语义敏感度才需要建模。我们的 agent 一旦接入符号规划器，这套评测口径可以直接搬。证据边界：七个 STRIPS domain、BFS 最优规划长度，属玩具设定，向真实工具链的外推需重做；h_add 的 0.931 是 mean Spearman 绝对值的均值，样本量小。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：待核验/暂无。今日动作：存长尾；若引入符号规划器，用 rename-invariance 作为必测维度。
